title: setaria glauca var. elongata
intro: Setaria glauca var. elongata, commonly known as "yellow foxtail" or "wild millet", is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Setaria glauca var. elongata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
